chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 81: The Nunnery of Rot – Li Huowang’s Desperate Plea
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang climbs to the decrepit Anci Nunnery, hoping for an exorcist, but finds only a pack of filthy, laughing, pot-bellied nuns.
og_title: Anci Nunnery: Where the Bodhisattva Gathers Dust and the Nuns Eat Like Pigs
og_description: In his search for salvation, Li Huowang finds the most unholy sanctuary yet: a crumbling nunnery run by a pack of laughing, gluttonous nuns.
twitter_title: Li Huowang asks a nun for exorcism. She laughs at him. Everyone laughs.
twitter_description: The irony is not lost on Li Huowang; even he can't help but laugh along.
